clauses.clause: Terrain seams ≤ 2 cm, ≤ 25 / 9 detailed chunks, no input freeze on streaming.
clauses.note: All172paired terrain boundaries/43140exhaustive affine-partition samples have0missing support and maxgap0.01000000024m (<0.02m); all97runtime-asset hashes match. Unpaired permanent structural/horizon faces are not paired terrain seams.
